critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated checks report no confirmed violations, no horizontal document overflow, no touch-target violations, successful keyboard traversal to #precedent, a measurable skip-link target, and reduced-motion rendering with no transform or opacity animation. However, results remain incomplete at every viewport: 6 serious aria-prohibited-attr nodes, 2 critical duplicate-id-aria nodes, and 553/508/484 serious color-contrast nodes on desktop/tablet/mobile. There is also no measured proof of visible focus, screen-reader semantics, or complete keyboard operation within the precedent content.
critique.fix: Resolve and rerun all incomplete audits: remove prohibited ARIA attributes, make every ARIA/label ID unique, and verify each flagged foreground/background pair meets WCAG contrast. Add measured evidence for visible focus, semantic names/roles/states, reading order, and keyboard activation of every interactive element at all three viewports.
